437:t_2:77.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Right... She'll end up in the same state $n is in right now.」

437:t_2:79.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I won't be able to see Miss $$スズネ$$ anymore...?」

437:t_2:82.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Come to think of it, your whole life has been one loss after another of the people you love.」

437:t_2:83.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「But that despair awakened the $$いがみ合う双子$$. Heh heh... Perhaps I should thank God.」

437:t_2:84.en:
???
「Thank...? That's enough of your mockery, once and for all!」

437:t_2:86.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Who am I supposed to thank for something like this!?」

437:t_2:87.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You must know it too! That $n has always longed for a normal life!」

437:t_2:88.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Going to school, playing with friends, falling in love, living with hope and dreams for the future...! And yet...!」

437:t_2:90.en:
$$刹那$$
「So even she, who was sinking into the depths of $$アムブリエル$$'s consciousness, answered our call!」

437:t_2:91.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「So what do you want? Don't tell me you've come to save $n now, of all times.」

437:t_2:92.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And what's so strange about that!?」

437:t_2:93.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's useless. Even with this many people calling out to him, $n won't wake up.」

437:t_2:96.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The best proof is that I, who was thought to have sunk into the depths of consciousness, am here like this.」

437:t_2:97.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Besides, $n is already on the verge of waking up.」

437:t_2:99.en:
$$スズネ$$
「True, $n has had people dear to him taken from him again and again.」

437:t_2:100.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But the people here... his comrades and friends are with him! $n is not alone!」

437:t_2:102.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n... You're almost there, aren't you?」

437:t_2:104.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let me be the one to give the final push...」

437:t_2:105.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're my partner... Because you're someone precious to me.」

437:t_2:108.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That is the hope that lies beyond the taboo.」

437:t_3:3.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Hangar ～

437:t_3:6.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I knew it, you're the best, $n! I won't give you up to anyone, okay!?」

437:t_3:7.en:
$n
「I'm not the best. It's everyone who saved me.」

437:t_3:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「You always make us take care of you, every single time.」

437:t_3:10.en:
$n
「I never thought I'd hear that from you.」

437:t_3:11.en:
$n
「But I really am grateful. Thank you, everyone.」

437:t_3:14.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Even the quiet type has started to look natural when he laughs.」

437:t_3:15.en:
$n
「Until recently, people said my smile was as scary as yours, $$竜馬$$.」

437:t_3:16.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Why, you punk! Even after going through all that hell, you still haven't kicked the habit of talking back!」

437:t_3:17.en:
$$タケル$$
「Still, you did well to make it back from that situation.」

437:t_3:19.en:
$$刹那$$
「But even before we touched your heart, you were already trying to move forward.」

437:t_3:21.en:
$$シン$$
「Did $$ＡＧ$$ do something? Like use some dangerous drug, or some weird hypnosis...」

437:t_3:22.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Sounds just like the tuning of an enhanced human.」

437:t_3:23.en:
$$フォウ$$
「But it wouldn't surprise me if $$ＡＧ$$ did it.」

437:t_3:25.en:
$n
「'The final adjustments on the $$ジェニオン$$ are complete... Depending on me, the $$ジェニオン$$ will show its full power'... That's what I was told.」

437:t_3:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good, good. It seems you heard me just fine.」

437:t_3:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Personally, if even that hadn't worked, I would have had no choice but to resort to mental control through drug administration or post-hypnosis, you see.」

437:t_3:28.en:
$$クェス$$
「I knew it! You had a trick like that ready!」

437:t_3:29.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Cut it out, $$クェス$$. It never actually happened, after all...」

437:t_3:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... it was a dangerous gamble, but the result was a victory beyond even my expectations.」

437:t_3:34.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Even so, I will never again permit you to endanger the lives of our crew on your own authority.」

437:t_3:35.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That blow just now was on behalf of $c.」

437:t_3:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ow, ow, ow... As expected, $$スメラギ$$'s slap really does sting...」

437:t_3:38.en:
$$青山$$
「But $$クロウ$$... Why did you fall for this guy's sweet talk?」

437:t_3:39.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Yeah! And you're always going around saying you hate gambling!」

437:t_3:40.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I can't say exactly why, but somehow I feel I can trust $$ＡＧ$$...」

437:t_3:42.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No... I know it's suspicious myself...!」

437:t_3:43.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But I can't help feeling $$ＡＧ$$ would never, ever cross that last line...」

437:t_3:45.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm sorry... Maybe I'm just nervous because of $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, but I can't really agree...」

437:t_3:46.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Right... I don't understand myself, either.」

437:t_3:47.en:
$$桂$$
「But Dr. $$トライア$$ gets along with $$ＡＧ$$, too...」

437:t_3:48.en:
$$デュオ$$
「So it's some phenomenon unique to $$スコート・ラボ$$?」

437:t_3:49.en:
$$カトル$$
「I don't really know, but it seems that way...」

437:t_3:50.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now, everyone... My good points are clear to those who can see them, so...」
